title: Alibi and Verdict
author: Ulyana Joubert
blurb: Xanthe Zhou, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
